findings.contract: SOURCE-CAPTURE-R1 I/O contract requires refusal of hardlinks and reuse must verify an existing safe exact .md sibling.
findings.evidence: A disposable Vault with a real applied generic capture was modified by unlinking .raw/captured/<sha>.md and hardlinking an identical external file at that exact slot. inspect_markdown_capture returned {state:capture_reused, authority.disposition:reuse} while st_nlink=2.
findings.impact: An unsafe external inode can be treated as a reusable captured source and then cited by later admission; admission audit may catch it later, but inspect has already emitted a reusable authority.
findings.suggested_fix: At the Markdown adapter boundary, require the selected .md sibling to be regular, single-link (st_nlink==1), and stable across the retained snapshot; expose enough descriptor state from capture_snapshot or add an adapter-side no-follow stat check.
findings.title: Reuse inspection accepts a hardlinked captured Markdown sibling
